articles.summary: The RealReal (Nasdaq: REAL), the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated luxury resale, today announced the opening of its newest Los Angeles-area store at 230 S Brand Blvd, Glendale, CA on October 1, 2026 . The new location expands The RealReal's Southern California presence and brings its full-service luxury consignment and shopping experience to a new community of buyers and consignors across Glendale and the greater Los Angeles area. The new store combines The RealReal's industry-leading authentication expertise with personalized consignment services and a curated shopping experience. Customers can consign, shop and discover authenticated luxury across women's and men's fashion, handbags, fine jewelry, watches and accessories. Glendale was a natural choice for The RealReal's newest Los Angeles-area location. articles.summary: The RealReal (Nasdaq: REAL), the world's largest online marketplace for authenticated luxury resale, today announced the opening of its first Massachusetts store at The Street Chestnut Hill on October 15. Located at 27 Boylston Street, Suite 205, Chestnut Hill, the new store brings The RealReal's full-service luxury consignment experience to Greater Boston for the first time, making it easier for the region's growing community of buyers and consignors to shop and sell luxury in person. The new 1800 sq. ft. store combines The RealReal's industry-leading authentication expertise with personalized consignment services and a curated shopping experience. Customers can consign, shop and discover authenticated luxury across women's and men's fashion, handbags, fine jewelry, watches and accessories.
